messages.subject: seeking assistance in cfa model built
parts:
Dear all,

I would like to perform a CFA in lavaan but i'm struggling to set up the model (very new to lavaan!)
I have a 3 factor scale with 4 items in every scale.

So far I have this: 


 
library(foreign)
file.choose()
dataset = read.spss("H:\\My Documents\\Valideringsstudie AISI 6-12\\aisi.sav", to.data.frame=TRUE)


install.packages("lavaan", dependencies = TRUE)
library(lavaan)

aisi.model <- ’ Avoidant =~ A8 + A9 + A11 + A14
Ambivalent =~ C6 + C10 + C16 + C20
Desorganized =~ D1 + D7 + D12 + D18 ’





If I try to run the aisi.model syntax, i get this:

> aisi.model <- ’ avoidant =~ A8 + A9 + A11 + A14
Error: unexpected input in "aisi.model <- ’"
> Ambivalent =~ C6 + C10 + C16 + C20
> Desorganized =~ D1 + D7 + D12 + D18 ’
Error: unexpected input in "Desorganized =~ D1 + D7 + D12 + D18 ’"



I'm probably doing so much wrong, can somebody help me out?
